questions.text: Explain aggregate demand and its components.
questions.expectedAnswer: Aggregate demand: C + I + G + (X - M)
questions.markingGuide: Identify and explain components of aggregate demand.

questions.text: Analyse factors affecting aggregate supply in economy.
questions.expectedAnswer: Factors: labour, capital, technology, input prices affecting supply.
questions.markingGuide: Explain short-run and long-run aggregate supply determinants.

questions.text: Analyse macroeconomic equilibrium and policy effectiveness.
questions.expectedAnswer: Show how demand and supply determine output, price level, employment.
questions.markingGuide: Evaluate policy effectiveness in reaching macroeconomic objectives.

questions.text: Comprehensive macroeconomic analysis and policy evaluation.
questions.expectedAnswer: Integrate AD/AS analysis with policy evaluation and economic objectives.
questions.markingGuide: Sophisticated analysis of macro equilibrium and policy trade-offs.
